dedupe_keys.name: global stations wfp sdi t logistics database

description: Global stations (WFP SDI-T - Logistics Database) is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by WFP - World Food Programme. This layer contains information about global station of bus, train and ferry. Coverage: not tied to one country in the listing. The portal files it under the publisher WFP - World Food Programme. Its tags are facilities-infrastructure, geodata, railways, transportation. It offers 3 resource(s) in GEOJSON, SHP, TXT. The portal shows 2025-08-26 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution Share-Alike (CC BY-SA). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support freight and delivery logistics studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
